title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is grappling with a mix of resilience initiatives and ongoing challenges, from satellite communications to launch site security. Meanwhile, budget allocations are shifting, and some companies are trying to navigate the rocky terrain of defense contracts.

themes.title: Satellite Communications Resilience
themes.body: Efforts to bolster satellite communications are underway, reflecting a growing recognition of vulnerabilities in current systems. The FCC's impending vote on licensing overhaul may further shape this landscape.

themes.title: Launch Site Security Concerns
themes.body: Drones are emerging as a significant threat to U.S. rocket launch sites, raising alarms about security protocols. As the industry pushes for more resilient operations, this issue could prompt regulatory changes.

themes.title: Budget Boost for Space Resilience
themes.body: The recent $1.4 billion addition to the space resilience line in the FY27 budget signals a shift towards prioritizing national security in space. This funding could catalyze new projects and partnerships within the defense sector.

themes.title: Defense-Tech IPO Activity
themes.body: The defense-tech sector is showing signs of life, with discussions around IPOs gaining traction. As companies like Palantir secure extensions on key contracts, the market may be warming up to new entrants.
